ModMetaData.name: Colony Summary
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a Summary tab that shows every colonist's gear in one table.
Each row shows a colonist's weapon, worn apparel and inventory as icons, with their overall sharp, blunt and heat armor, comfortable temperature range and mass carried. Damaged items show a condition bar. Hover over an item to see its name, quality and condition, and click it to open its info card. Click a column header to sort by it, and click a colonist's name to jump to them.
Colonists in caravans and transporters are listed too.
Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
